entities.name: Alpharael
entities.description: A young human Monoist cleric from the Monasteriat in the Edge, touched by the Endstone, who lost his right hand to a singularity bead.

entities.name: Raphaella
entities.description: Alpharael's twin sister, who undertook the Plummet into Sothera.

entities.name: Endstone
entities.description: A powerful object that revises timelines and seems to call for a wielder; Alpharael is in contact with it.

entities.name: Vondam
entities.description: A Sunstar Solar Knight who pursues Alpharael to learn what caused his timeline.

entities.name: Haliya
entities.description: Vondam's squire, who loses faith in the Summists after Vondam slaughters the Kav citizens.

entities.name: Sami
entities.description: A rogue who rescued Alpharael and works for Tezzeret.

entities.name: Tannuk
entities.description: A rogue who rescued Alpharael alongside Sami.

entities.name: Captain Slats
entities.description: Astelli captain who sentenced Alpharael to live and offered him an escape aircraft.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: Sami's employer, who wanted to learn the Endstone's objective.

entities.name: Kavaron
entities.description: Location whose debris field Alpharael crashed into.

entities.name: Infinite Guideline Station
entities.description: Station where Summists and Monoists converged to intercept the Endstone.

entities.name: Dawnsire
entities.description: Sunstar cruiser Alpharael boarded in a suicide mission.

entities.name: Sothera
entities.description: Star system where the Sunstar attempted to revive the star with a horizon javelin.

entities.name: Summists
entities.description: Faction dealing with the Endstone whose objectives Haliya came to doubt.

entities.name: Sunstar Company
entities.description: Force of Vondam and Haliya that attacked the defenders of Kavaron.

entities.name: Vaar
entities.description: Group that took the Endstone away at the Wurmwall.

entities.name: Wurmwall
entities.description: Place to which the crew warped from the station.

events.summary: Raphaella undertakes the Plummet into Sothera and falls; in grief Alpharael joins a suicide mission to board the Dawnsire.
events.quote: Alpharael joined a suicide mission to board the Dawnsire out of grief and despair at his sister's death.

events.summary: Shot during the attack, Alpharael throws the singularity bead, destroying Vondam's head and his own hand; a timeline revision by the Endstone leaves only holes, and Captain Slats lets him escape.
events.quote: After being shot by a bladiator in the attack, Alpharael realized that he didn't want to die.

events.summary: Pursued by Vondam, Alpharael is shot down in the debris field of Kavaron and rescued by Sami and Tannuk.
events.quote: Alpharael was shot down and crashed in the debris field of Kavaron

events.summary: Haliya tries to force Alpharael to alter the past; Vondam slaughters the Kav citizens, convincing Haliya the Summists were wrong, and the crew escapes.
events.quote: Vondam refused to hurt Haliya and opened fire on the Kav citizens instead, slaughtering them all.

events.summary: Tezzeret meets the crew and a dice roll sends them to Infinite Guideline Station.
events.quote: Tezzeret found that it wanted them to go to Infinite Guideline Station

events.summary: Alpharael and Haliya duel Vondam together and win; the crew warps to the Wurmwall, where the Vaar take the Endstone.
events.quote: the Endstone was taken away by the Vaar

relations.quote: He had a twin sister named Raphaella
He is an acolyte of the Monoist faith

relations.note: Pursued him and duelled him at the station.
relations.quote: Pursued by Vondam's Palestar patrol ship
